Name: Android Connected Chest Workbenches
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][b]Android Connected Chest Workbenches[/b][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Makes vanilla Workbenches use materials from all connected chests on Android.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Normally, a Workbench only sees chests placed directly around it. This mod lets it follow the entire connected chest network instead.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Chests can connect by their sides [b]or diagonally[/b], and the connection continues through as many touching chests as you have.[/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS]The Workbench will see and use crafting materials from all of them.[/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][b]Features[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Workbenches see materials from the full connected chest network. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Materials stored across multiple connected chests can be combined for recipes. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Crafting consumes the required materials directly from those connected chests. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Side and diagonal connections both count. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Keeps the [b]vanilla Android crafting interface[/b].[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Android only[/b][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]This mod was made specifically for the Android version of Stardew Valley. Desktop support is not a goal.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][b]Tested with[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15.3 Android[/b] [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI [b]4.3.2.5[/b] [/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Requirements[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI for Android [/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]No other mods are required. [/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][b]Credits[/b][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Created by [b]KhaStark[/b].[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Inspired by the connected-chest convenience of [b]Workbench Helper by Ballom41[/b].[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]This mod is written from scratch and does [b]not[/b] contain Workbench Helper code, DLLs, or assets.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][b]Version 1.0.0[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Initial release. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Full connected-chest network support. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Side and diagonal chest connections. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Connected chest materials are recognized and consumed normally. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Vanilla Android crafting UI preserved.[/font][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Android Connected Chest Workbenches
Manifest.Description: Lets Android workbenches see and consume crafting materials from all chests connected through a touching chest network, with optional compatibility for Touch UI Enhanced.
